questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.a: Philippine coral reefs are valuable but threatened and need joint protection.
d: Tourism is the main cause of coral reef damage.
Coral reefs can recover quickly without human help.
Dynamite fishing is the only threat to coral reefs.
questions.e: The passage describes the value of reefs, the threats to them, and the call for joint protection.
questions.p: The Philippine archipelago is home to some of the richest coral reefs in the world. These reefs serve as breeding grounds for fish, protect coastlines from strong waves, and attract tourists who bring income to coastal communities. However, illegal fishing methods such as dynamite and cyanide fishing, as well as pollution and rising sea temperatures, have damaged a large portion of these reefs. Marine scientists warn that unless communities, government and businesses work together to protect them, many reefs may not recover within our lifetime.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of coral reefs?

They protect coastlines from strong waves.
questions.e: Drinking water is not mentioned in the passage.

questions.q: According to the passage, why are government employees accountable to the people?
questions.a: Because their salaries are paid with public funds.
d: Because they are elected by the people.
Because they are required to pass an exam.
questions.e: "Because public funds pay their salaries, they are accountable to the people at all times."
questions.p: Public service is often described as a calling rather than a mere job. A government employee is expected to serve the public with integrity, courtesy and efficiency. Because public funds pay their salaries, they are accountable to the people at all times. Small acts, such as answering inquiries promptly or explaining requirements clearly, build public trust. On the other hand, delays, rudeness and favoritism erode that trust and make citizens doubt the government's ability to deliver services.

questions.q: The word "erode" in the passage most nearly means:
questions.e: Delays and rudeness slowly wear away public trust.

questions.q: Ano ang pangunahing kaisipan ng talata?
questions.a: Maraming kabutihang naidudulot ang pagbabasa kaya dapat itong gawing ugali.
d: Mas mabuti ang paglalakbay kaysa pagbabasa.
Walang saysay ang lahat ng uri ng libangan.
Ang mga aklat ay para lamang sa mga mag-aaral.
questions.e: Inilalahad ng talata ang mga benepisyo ng pagbabasa at hinihikayat ang mga kabataan na magbasa araw-araw.
questions.p: Ang pagbabasa ay isa sa pinakamabisang paraan upang mapalawak ang kaalaman. Sa bawat aklat na binubuklat, nakapaglalakbay tayo sa iba't ibang lugar at panahon nang hindi umaalis sa ating kinauupuan. Bukod dito, napauunlad ng pagbabasa ang ating talasalitaan at kakayahang mag-isip nang kritikal. Kaya naman, hinihikayat ang mga kabataan na gawing bahagi ng kanilang araw-araw na gawain ang pagbabasa, sa halip na ubusin ang oras sa walang saysay na libangan.

questions.q: According to the passage, why do many organizations adopt a hybrid arrangement?
questions.a: To balance the benefits of remote work with the need for teamwork and connection
d: Because remote work is less productive
questions.e: Hybrid work addresses isolation and teamwork issues while keeping the benefits of remote work.
questions.p: Remote work became widespread during the pandemic. Many employees discovered that they could be just as productive at home, saving hours that used to be spent in traffic. Employers, meanwhile, found that they could reduce office costs. Still, remote work has drawbacks. Some workers feel isolated, and teams may find it harder to build trust and share ideas informally. For this reason, many organizations now adopt a hybrid arrangement, in which employees work from home on some days and in the office on others.

questions.q: Which is mentioned as a drawback of remote work?
d: Employees spend more time in traffic.
questions.e: The passage says "Some workers feel isolated."

questions.q: What is the main point of the passage?
questions.a: The impact of typhoons can be reduced through preparedness and planning.
d: Typhoons can be prevented with technology.
Evacuation centers are no longer needed.
questions.e: The passage stresses reducing impact through warning systems, planning and preparedness.
questions.p: Typhoons are a regular part of life in the Philippines, with around twenty entering the country's area of responsibility each year. While these storms cannot be prevented, their impact can be reduced. Early warning systems, well-planned evacuation centers and stricter building codes have saved many lives. Experts also stress the importance of community preparedness: families who know their evacuation routes and keep emergency kits ready are far more likely to stay safe.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.a: Neither the manager nor the employees were informed.
d: Neither the manager nor the employees was informed.
Neither the manager or the employees were informed.
Neither the manager nor the employees has been informed.
questions.e: With "neither...nor," the verb agrees with the nearer subject ("employees" → were).

questions.q: Each of the applicants ___ required to submit a résumé.
questions.e: "Each" is singular, so it takes "is."

questions.q: The committee ___ already submitted its report.
questions.e: A collective noun acting as one unit ("its report") takes a singular verb.

questions.q: She is one of the employees who ___ always on time.
questions.e: "Who" refers to "employees" (plural), so the verb is "are."

questions.q: If I ___ the director, I would approve the proposal.
questions.e: Use the subjunctive "were" for hypothetical situations.

questions.q: The documents were given to Maria and ___.
questions.e: Use the object pronoun "me" after the preposition "to."

questions.q: By the time the guests arrived, we ___ dinner.
questions.e: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.q: She has been working in this office ___ 2019.
questions.e: Use "since" with a specific point in time.

questions.q: He has been working here ___ five years.
questions.e: Use "for" with a period of time.

questions.q: There are ___ applicants this year than last year.
questions.e: Use "fewer" with countable nouns.

questions.q: Please submit the report ___ Friday.
questions.e: "By Friday" means no later than Friday.

questions.q: The new policy will ___ all employees.
questions.e: "Affect" is usually a verb (to influence); "effect" is usually a noun (result).

questions.q: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.a: The employees' lounge is on the second floor.
d: The employee's lounge are on the second floor.
The employees lounge' is on the second floor.
The employees's lounge is on the second floor.
questions.e: For plural nouns ending in -s, add only an apostrophe: employees'.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
questions.a: It's important to know its purpose.
d: Its important to know it's purpose.
It's important to know it's purpose.
Its important to know its purpose.
questions.e: "It's" = it is; "its" = possessive.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.a: They submitted their forms over there.
d: They're submitted there forms over their.
There submitted their forms over they're.
They submitted there forms over their.
questions.e: "They" = subject, "their" = possessive, "there" = place.

questions.q: The number of applicants ___ increasing every year.
questions.e: "The number of" takes a singular verb; "a number of" takes a plural verb.

questions.q: A number of employees ___ attending the seminar.
questions.e: "A number of" means "many," so it takes a plural verb.

questions.q: Mathematics ___ my favorite subject in school.
questions.e: Subjects like mathematics, physics and economics are singular.

questions.q: Between you and ___, the plan will not work.
questions.e: After a preposition ("between"), use the object pronoun "me."

questions.q: Of the two proposals, this one is ___.
questions.e: Use the comparative form when comparing two things.

questions.q: She sings ___ than her sister.
questions.e: Use the adverb "beautifully" to describe how she sings, in comparative form.

questions.q: The supervisor, along with his staff, ___ attending the meeting.
questions.e: Phrases like "along with" do not change the subject; "supervisor" is singular.

questions.q: I would have passed the exam if I ___ harder.
questions.e: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.

questions.q: Choose the sentence with correct parallel structure.
questions.a: She likes reading, writing, and painting.
d: She likes reading, writing, and to paint.
She likes to read, writing, and painting.
She likes reading, to write, and paint.
questions.e: Items in a series should have the same grammatical form.

questions.q: Neither of the reports ___ complete.
questions.e: "Neither" as a pronoun is singular.

questions.q: The memo was written by the director ___ was approved by the board.
questions.e: "And" joins two related actions.

questions.q: He didn't say ___ to anyone about the incident.
questions.e: Avoid double negatives: "didn't say anything."

questions.q: The clerk ___ the files yesterday.
questions.e: "Yesterday" signals the simple past tense.

questions.q: The applicant asked me where ___.
questions.e: In indirect questions, use statement word order.

questions.q: Everybody ___ to bring a valid ID.
questions.e: "Everybody" is singular.

questions.q: Identify the error: "Each (A) of the (B) students (C) have submitted (D) their projects."
questions.e: "Each" is singular → "has submitted."

questions.q: Identify the error: "She (A) don't (B) like (C) waiting in (D) long lines."
questions.e: With "she," use "doesn't."

questions.q: Identify the error: "The (A) informations you (B) gave (C) were very (D) helpful."
questions.e: "Information" is uncountable; it should be "The information... was very helpful."

questions.q: Identify the error: "He (A) is (B) more taller (C) than (D) his brother."
questions.e: Use "taller," not "more taller."

questions.q: Identify the error: "(A) Me and Ana (B) went to the (C) office (D) early."
questions.e: Use the subject pronoun: "Ana and I went..."

questions.q: Identify the error: "The (A) team (B) are (C) planning (D) its next project."
questions.e: Since "its" treats the team as one unit, the verb should be "is."

questions.q: The manager praised her for being ___; she always finished tasks ahead of schedule.
questions.e: Finishing tasks ahead of schedule shows punctuality.

questions.q: Because the instructions were so ___, nobody knew what to do.
questions.e: Unclear (vague) instructions cause confusion.

questions.q: The official was ___ for his honesty; he never accepted bribes.
questions.e: "Renowned" means famous for something good.

questions.q: The town was ___ after the typhoon; houses and roads were destroyed.
questions.e: Destroyed houses and roads mean the town was devastated.

questions.q: Her ___ attitude made her popular among her co-workers.
questions.e: An amiable (friendly) attitude makes one popular.

questions.q: The data are ___; we cannot draw a conclusion until more information is collected.
questions.e: Inconclusive data do not lead to a firm conclusion.

questions.q: Despite his ___ background, he became one of the richest businessmen in the country.
questions.e: "Despite" signals contrast with becoming rich.

questions.q: What does "to burn the midnight oil" mean?
questions.a: to work or study late into the night
questions.e: This idiom means to stay up late working or studying.

questions.q: What does "to break the ice" mean?
questions.a: to ease tension and start a conversation
questions.e: Breaking the ice makes people feel more comfortable.

questions.q: What does "a piece of cake" mean?
questions.e: "A piece of cake" means very easy.

questions.q: What does "to hit the nail on the head" mean?
questions.a: to describe exactly what is causing a situation
questions.e: It means to be exactly right.

questions.q: What does "once in a blue moon" mean?
questions.e: "Once in a blue moon" means very rarely.

questions.q: What does "to beat around the bush" mean?
questions.a: to avoid talking about the main point
questions.e: It means to avoid getting to the point.

questions.q: What does "to cost an arm and a leg" mean?
questions.e: It means very expensive.

questions.q: What does "to be on the same page" mean?
questions.a: to agree or have the same understanding
questions.e: It means to share the same understanding.

questions.q: Piliin ang wastong pangungusap.
questions.e: Ginagamit ang "nang" bilang pang-abay na naglalarawan sa pandiwa (paano tumakbo).

questions.q: Bumili ___ bigas si Nanay sa palengke.
questions.e: Ang "ng" ay ginagamit bago ang pangngalan (bigas) bilang layon.

questions.q: Piliin ang wastong gamit: "Masaya ___ siya dahil pumasa siya sa pagsusulit."
questions.e: Ginagamit ang "raw" kapag ang salitang sinusundan ay nagtatapos sa patinig (masaya).

questions.q: Piliin ang wastong gamit: "Pumasa ___ ang kapatid ko."
questions.e: Ginagamit ang "rin" pagkatapos ng salitang nagtatapos sa patinig (pumasa).

questions.q: Piliin ang wastong gamit: "Mag-aaral ___ siya ng abogasya."
questions.e: Ginagamit ang "daw" kapag ang sinusundang salita ay nagtatapos sa katinig (mag-aaral).

questions.q: Alin ang wastong pangungusap?
questions.a: Pinahiran niya ng pintura ang pader.
d: Pinahirin niya ng pintura ang pader.
Pinahiran niya nang pintura ang pader.
Pinahirin niya nang pintura ang pader.
questions.e: Ang "pahiran" ay paglalagay (pintura sa pader); ang "pahirin" ay pag-aalis (pahirin ang pawis). Ang "ng" ay ginagamit bago ang pangngalan.

questions.q: Alin ang wastong gamit ng "subukin" at "subukan"?
questions.a: Subukin mo ang bagong resipe; subukan mo kung ano ang ginagawa nila.
d: Subukan mo ang bagong resipe; subukin mo kung ano ang ginagawa nila.
questions.e: Ang "subukin" ay pagsubok o pagtikim; ang "subukan" ay palihim na pagmamasid.

questions.q: Ano ang kahulugan ng sawikaing "nagbibilang ng poste"?
questions.e: Ang "nagbibilang ng poste" ay tumutukoy sa taong walang hanapbuhay.

questions.q: Ano ang kahulugan ng sawikaing "balat-sibuyas"?
questions.e: Ang taong balat-sibuyas ay madaling masaktan ang damdamin.

questions.q: Ano ang kahulugan ng sawikaing "itaga sa bato"?
questions.e: Ang "itaga sa bato" ay nangangahulugang tandaan nang mabuti.

questions.q: Ano ang kahulugan ng sawikaing "kapit sa patalim"?
questions.a: gumagawa ng masama dahil sa matinding pangangailangan
questions.e: Ang "kapit sa patalim" ay paggawa ng mapanganib o masama dahil sa kagipitan.

questions.q: Ano ang kahulugan ng sawikaing "ningas-kugon"?
questions.e: Ang ningas-kugon ay sigla sa umpisa na mabilis nawawala.

questions.q: Alin ang tamang baybay?
questions.e: Ang wastong anyo ay "pakikipagkapwa-tao."

questions.q: Piliin ang wastong pangungusap.
questions.a: Kailangang dalhin mo ang iyong ID bukas.
d: Kailangan dalhin mo ang iyong ID bukas.
Kailangang dalhin mo nang iyong ID bukas.
Kailangan nang dalhin mo ang iyong ID bukas.
questions.e: Ginagamit ang pang-angkop na "-ng" kapag ang salita ay nagtatapos sa "n": kailangan + -g = kailangang.

questions.q:
Arrange the sentences to form a logical paragraph:
(1) Finally, submit the form to the window clerk.
(2) First, get an application form from the information desk.
(3) Then, attach a photocopy of your valid ID.
(4) Next, fill out the form completely.
questions.e: The transition words First, Next, Then, Finally show the order.

questions.q:
Arrange the sentences to form a logical paragraph:
(1) As a result, many residents were evacuated.
(2) A strong typhoon hit the province last week.
(3) The heavy rains caused flooding in low-lying areas.
(4) Relief goods were later distributed to the evacuees.
questions.e: Cause (typhoon) → effect (flooding) → result (evacuation) → aftermath (relief).

questions.q: DOCTOR : HOSPITAL :: TEACHER : ___
questions.e: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school.

questions.q: PEN : WRITE :: KNIFE : ___
questions.e: A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut.

questions.q: PUPPY : DOG :: KITTEN : ___
questions.e: A puppy is a young dog; a kitten is a young cat.

questions.q: HOT : COLD :: LIGHT : ___
questions.e: Antonyms: hot/cold, light/dark.

questions.q: FINGER : HAND :: TOE : ___
questions.e: A finger is part of a hand; a toe is part of a foot.

questions.q: AUTHOR : NOVEL :: COMPOSER : ___
questions.e: An author creates a novel; a composer creates a symphony.

questions.q: BIRD : FLOCK :: FISH : ___
questions.e: A group of birds is a flock; a group of fish is a school.

questions.q: THERMOMETER : TEMPERATURE :: BAROMETER : ___
questions.e: A thermometer measures temperature; a barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.q: CARPENTER : HAMMER :: SURGEON : ___
questions.e: Worker : tool.

questions.q: BREAD : BAKER :: SHOES : ___
questions.e: A baker makes bread; a cobbler makes or repairs shoes.

questions.q: DROUGHT : WATER :: FAMINE : ___
questions.e: A drought is a lack of water; a famine is a lack of food.

questions.q: PAGE : BOOK :: STEP : ___
questions.e: A page is part of a book; a step is part of a staircase.

questions.q: EAR : HEAR :: NOSE : ___
questions.e: Organ : function.

questions.q: INCH : FOOT :: CENTIMETER : ___
questions.e: A smaller unit to a larger unit of the same system of length.

questions.q: ARCHIPELAGO : ISLANDS :: CONSTELLATION : ___
questions.e: An archipelago is a group of islands; a constellation is a group of stars.

questions.q: GENEROUS : STINGY :: BRAVE : ___
questions.e: Antonyms.

questions.q: SEED : TREE :: EGG : ___
questions.e: A seed grows into a tree; an egg develops into a bird.

questions.q: PILOT : AIRPLANE :: CAPTAIN : ___
questions.e: The person in command of the vehicle.

questions.q: LIBRARY : BOOKS :: ARCHIVE : ___
questions.e: A library keeps books; an archive keeps records.

questions.q: CLOCK : TIME :: SCALE : ___
questions.e: A clock measures time; a scale measures weight.

questions.q: Statement: "All applicants must submit a medical certificate." Ana is an applicant. Which conclusion follows?
questions.a: Ana must submit a medical certificate.
d: Ana is not required to submit anything.
Only Ana must submit a medical certificate.
questions.e: Since all applicants must submit one and Ana is an applicant, she must submit one.

questions.q: Statement: "If it rains, the event will be moved indoors." The event was NOT moved indoors. What can be concluded?
questions.e: Contrapositive: if not moved indoors, then it did not rain.

questions.q: Statement: "If it rains, the event will be moved indoors." The event was moved indoors. What can be concluded with certainty?
questions.a: Nothing can be concluded with certainty about the rain.
questions.e: Affirming the consequent is a fallacy: the event could have been moved indoors for another reason.

questions.q: Ben is taller than Carl. Carl is taller than Dan. Dan is taller than Ed. Who is the shortest?
questions.e: Order from tallest: Ben > Carl > Dan > Ed.

questions.q: Liza is older than Mae but younger than Nora. Olga is older than Nora. Who is the oldest?
questions.e: Mae < Liza < Nora < Olga.

questions.q: Five friends sit in a row. Ana is at the left end. Ben sits next to Ana. Carlo sits in the middle. Dina sits at the right end. Where does Ella sit?
questions.e: Positions: 1 Ana, 2 Ben, 3 Carlo, 4 Ella, 5 Dina.

questions.q: Pointing to a man, Rosa said, "He is the son of my mother's only son." How is the man related to Rosa?
questions.e: Her mother's only son is her brother; his son is her nephew.

questions.q: Mario is the father of Jun. Jun is the brother of Lisa. Lisa is the mother of Paolo. How is Mario related to Paolo?
questions.e: Mario is Lisa's father, and Lisa is Paolo's mother.

questions.q: A is the sister of B. B is the son of C. How is C related to A?
questions.e: B is C's son and A is B's sister, so C is A's parent.

questions.q: Statement: "The office will start accepting online applications to reduce long lines." Which is an assumption behind this statement?
questions.a: Many applicants are able to apply online.
d: Long lines are good for business.
No one will apply in person anymore.
questions.e: The plan only works if applicants can use the online system.

questions.q: Statement: "Buy our vitamins and never get sick again." Which assumption is implied?
questions.a: People want to avoid getting sick.
questions.e: The ad appeals to people's desire to stay healthy.

questions.q: Which word does NOT belong to the group?
questions.e: Carrot is a vegetable; the others are fruits.

questions.q: Which word does NOT belong to the group?
questions.e: The others are birds.

questions.q: Which word does NOT belong to the group?
questions.e: Triangle is a two-dimensional figure; the others are three-dimensional.
